test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 18 April 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: According to the 2011 Census of India, which of the following states has a population density of 17 persons per sq km?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Arunachal Pradesh**__**.**

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• According to Census-2011, the population density of Arunachal Pradesh is only 17 people per square km.
 
• **According to the Census 2011, the population density of the states given in the option is** -
 
 
• Sikkim - 86 per sq km.
 
• Nagaland - 119 per sq km.
 
• Assam - 398 per sq km.
 
• **Among the states, Arunachal Pradesh has the lowest population density with 17 per sq km. **
 
• **The highest population density is in the NCT of Delhi with 11297 people per sq km.​**
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **The population density of India is 382.**
 
• Earlier, **in the 2001 Census,** the total **population density was 324.**
 
• As per the 2011 Census:
 
 
• The** most densely populated state in India is Bihar.**
 
 
• **Bihar** has a total** density of 1106.**
 
 
 
• The** least densely populated state **in India is** Arunachal Pradesh.**
 
 
• **Total Density: 17.**
 
 
 
• **Delhi **is the** most densely populated Union Territory in India. **
 
 
• **​**It has a total density of 11320.
 
 
 
• **Andaman and Nicobar Islands** is the** least densely populated UT in India.**
 
 
• Total Density: 46
